verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's RBAC includes a 'Pending' role, so new accounts need admin approval before they can use the assistant. That is a coarse form of approving who can drive it, and Channels let humans and AI share conversations. Nothing shows gating applied to inbound messages on those surfaces. Missing for 10: per-sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating in Channels or external messaging surfaces, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
